text: GDP growth exceeds expectations with industrial output and exports leading, while retail consumption and real estate remain weak. Energy price pressure and external conflict introduce visible constraints without altering current growth structure.

meta.note: Dual-state economy (external strength vs. internal weakness) creates classification tension; compression assigned to demand imbalance.

text: A large brokerage introduces direct crypto trading within its core platform, aligning digital assets with existing client portfolios. Traditional and crypto-native firms concurrently extend into each other's domains, creating overlapping service surfaces.

meta.note: Bridge and contest co-occur symmetrically across participants; expansion reflects mutual domain entry.
